The escape sequence closes the opening quote after v27_case09_slot0_early_risk, leaving the trailing ", " unterminated. Store the replacement loader body in a separate template file under research_artifacts/source_archives/ (or a .txt template next to the probe) and load it with Path.read_text; the template must contain no triple-quoted strings and no backslash-escaped double quotes. (2) Replace the failing inline membership test at line 255 with a marker-substring check on a module-level constant (for example FIND_SPEC_MARKER = 'find_spec("v27_case09_slot0_early_risk"') and report 'base.find_spec("' + 'v27_case09_slot0_early_risk' + '"' in new_func, or better report the marker presence directly so no nested quoting exists in the probe source at all. This parse gate is the acceptance-critical addition; it is what turned a 1-line typo into a wasted cycle. (4) Keep the existing idempotence branch (lines 213-225) and the pre-replacement archive write to research_artifacts/source_archives/ (a directory already exists at .../vehicle_true_variable_horizon_v34z2_environment_probe_v0_20260930T145547Z). (5) Keep the existing monkeypatch proof: temporarily replace base.load_contexts with a function that records the call and raises ContractError, confirm the patched v34z2.load_context_and_terminals() still returns the source242 context and that base_load_contexts_called is False, then restore. (6) Report field-by-field equality for context_id, state_label, source, case_snapshot, branch_step, tvp_start_index, state, previous_input, previous_input_source, horizons against an independently reconstructed reference built from base.v29.build_state_specs() and base.find_spec('v27_case09_slot0_early_risk'), mirroring the base source line 317-329 entry exactly. Do NOT weaken the equality evidence requirement; if any field mismatches, fail closed. DO NOT call any solver, do not construct an MPC, do not call env.step or env.reset after construction, do not train or refit, do not open validation64, do not touch sealed/final test. Do not modify experiments/bohn2021_aws/vehicle_true_variable_horizon_v34_objective_basin_solver_probe_v0.py. Do not modify experiments/bohn2021_aws/vehicle_true_variable_horizon_v34z2_converged_contract_gate_v0.py other than through the single load_context_and_terminals replacement.
